title: Bri Woodson: The Truth | Candidate For Ga 12th District | A Documentary
description:
VOTE: Ga 12th District May 19th ( Early Voting Ends TODAY. May 15th)
SEE:  @TheRealTabithaSpeaks Special On Bri Woodson HERE - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=StdP-wsneec&t=127s

🎬 Who is Bri Woodson really?

This documentary takes a deeper look at the candidate, the campaign, and the political fight unfolding in Georgia’s 12th Congressional District. This is the true story of a woman who has survived the worst things you can imagine, thrived in the face of adversity, stood in the face of authoritarianism and lives every day for others as a Clinical Mental Health Counselor finishing her Masters degree while running for congress. Bri Woodson is running in GA 12th district to save it from the like of Tori Branum. Branum is the candidate who called ICE on a Hyundai plant and started an international firestorm and potentially lost her district 8,000 jobs and more! 

Through interviews, behind-the-scenes moments, and political discussion, we explore the motivations, challenges, and ideas shaping Bri Woodson’s campaign and the broader conversation around the future of Georgia politics.

⚡ In this documentary:

🇺🇸 Bri Woodson’s political journey
🗳️ The battle for Georgia’s 12th District
🧠 Policy, strategy, and grassroots organizing
🔥 The realities of running for office today
⚠️ What this race could mean moving forward

This film explores Georgia politics, congressional campaigns, grassroots activism, and the changing political landscape in the South.
